curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: spell words with the letters Cc, Dd, and Ww for writing fluency

mission.title: C, D and W Word Workshop

interactions.prompt: Arrange the letters to spell dog.
interactions.retryHint: Start with d, then add o and g.

interactions.prompt: Match each starting letter to its word.
interactions.feedback: Great matching! C, d and w found their words.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Complete the word for something worn on the wrist: _atch.
interactions.feedback: Yes! w plus atch spells watch.

interactions.prompt: Which row spells all three picture words correctly: a cow, a desk and a web?
interactions.feedback: Excellent spelling! All three words are correct.
interactions.retryHint: Check the beginning and middle sound of each word.

interactions.prompt: Build the word 'crowd' from its sound parts.
interactions.feedback: Spelling star! cr-ow-d makes crowd and uses c, w and d.
interactions.retryHint: Start with cr, add the /ow/ part, then finish with d.
